name: Bybit $1.46B Cold-Wallet Hack (Lazarus / Safe{Wallet} supply-chain, Feb 21 2025)

window_utc.note: Acute exchange-solvency phase ended 2025-02-24 (ETH gap closed, 1:1 PoR); laundering phase complete 2025-03-04; price slide (hack sentiment entangled with tariff macro + record ETF outflows) reached local bottom 2025-03-10 on daily closes

speed: Theft: $1.46B in minutes (single masked transaction at 14:16 UTC, drained across ~40+ txs within ~2h). Bank-run phase: ~350k withdrawal requests in ~12h, ~$4-6B outflows in ~2 days. Solvency restored in ~72h. Market: ETH -3.1% d/d on hack day, then (entangled with tariff macro) -31.5% peak-to-trough over 3 weeks; BTC -19.7% over the same window. Laundering: 100% of ETH moved in 10 days.
summary: 21 февраля 2025: кража $1.46B ETH/stETH у Bybit (Lazarus; подмена UI Safe, слепая подпись delegatecall) — крупнейшая в истории. НО: биржа осталась платёжеспособной, выводы не закрывались (~350k заявок обработано, мосты-займы + выкуп ETH), паника погашена за 72 часа. DeFi не тронут, пеги идеальны. Урок: custody-hack БЕЗ инсолвентности ≠ bank run; урон книге — только компрессия APY на фоне макро-слива (−20-30% BTC/ETH за 3 недели, спутано с тарифным шоком). Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: Lazarus Group (UNC4899/TraderTraitor) compromises a Safe{Wallet} developer's macOS workstation via a trojanized Docker 'stock investment simulator' project; AWS session tokens hijacked, MFA bypassed (Safe/Mandiant findings)

Malicious JavaScript injected into app.safe.global frontend served from Safe{Wallet}'s AWS S3 bucket; payload activates ONLY for Bybit's ETH cold-wallet Safe address (plus one test address) — benign for all other users (Sygnia forensics)
ZachXBT links attacker addresses to Lazarus Group (overlap with Phemex hack clusters); ETH dips ~4% intraday on hack news (daily close -3.1% d/d: $2,740.7 -> $2,655.7, Coin Metrics)

Withdrawal run: ~350,000 withdrawal requests, ~99% processed within ~12 hours; total client outflows across assets estimated $4-6B. Bybit bridges the gap: ~40,000 ETH loan from Bitget, stETH from MEXC, whale deposits, OTC ETH buying via Galaxy Digital / FalconX / Wintermute

Mantle's mETH Protocol uses its 8-hour withdrawal delay window to pause cmETH withdrawals and claw back 15,000 cmETH (~$43M) from the attacker — the only large tranche recovered intact; withdrawal-delay design acted as protection

During a routine cold-to-warm ETH transfer, all three Bybit signers (incl. CEO Ben Zhou on a Ledger) blind-sign a masked transaction: UI displayed a legitimate transfer while the actual payload was a delegatecall swapping the Safe's mastercopy to an attacker contract. Wallet drained: ~401,347 ETH + ~90,375.5 stETH + 15,000 cmETH + 8,000 mETH ≈ $1.46B — largest crypto theft in history. Malicious JS removed from S3 ~2 minutes later
Ben Zhou publicly confirms the hack on X and holds a livestream: Bybit is solvent, client assets 1:1 backed, the loss can be covered — WITHDRAWALS STAY OPEN (the defining decision of the event)
Bybit buys back ~266,000 ETH (~$740M+) via OTC and exchanges; ETH daily close rebounds ABOVE pre-hack level to $2,821.9 on Feb 23 (Coin Metrics) — buyback bid + short squeeze

Bybit announces the ETH gap fully closed (~446,870 ETH ≈ $1.23B replenished via purchases, loans and deposits per Lookonchain) and publishes Hacken-verified proof-of-reserves confirming 1:1 backing — solvency restored within ~72h

Laundering sprint: 100% of ~499k ETH moved within 10 days, mostly swapped to BTC via THORChain (record ~$4.66B weekly volume, ~$5.5M fees). THORChain governance crisis: validators reverse a vote to block DPRK-linked flows; core dev 'Pluto' resigns. Chainflip ships a screening/blocking upgrade after Bybit's request; no-KYC exchange eXch refuses to block and processes tens of millions

Macro risk-off compounds the overhang: BTC's first daily close below $90k since Nov 2024 ($88,769.7, Coin Metrics; intraday drop reported ~6-7.5%) — driven primarily by confirmed US tariffs and a record ~$1.1B single-day US spot-BTC-ETF outflow, with the hack as sentiment overhang, not the main driver. Bybit launches LazarusBounty (10% of recovered funds)

FBI IC3 PSA formally attributes the theft to DPRK 'TraderTraitor' (Lazarus), publishes actor addresses, states funds are being converted to BTC and dispersed across thousands of addresses. Safe{Wallet} restores mainnet service on rebuilt, hardened infrastructure. BTC daily close $83,987.9 (-14.6% from Feb 20)
Ben Zhou traceability update: ~77% of stolen funds still traceable, ~20% gone dark (mixers), ~3% frozen (~$43M)

Safe{Wallet} + Mandiant publish forensic statement: compromised developer workstation -> hijacked AWS session tokens -> S3 JS injection targeted at Bybit; Bybit's own infrastructure was never breached (matching Sygnia's conclusion)
Entangled hack+macro slide bottoms locally: ETH daily close $1,879.7 (-31.5% from Feb 17 pre-hack peak; -33.4% from Feb 23 rebound high), BTC $79,006 (-19.7% from Feb 20 close) — Coin Metrics daily

German BKA seizes eXch servers and €34M in crypto (eXch had announced shutdown Apr 17) — the main non-compliant laundering venue taken down. BTC regained its pre-event close on 2025-05-08; ETH not until 2025-06-10 (Coin Metrics daily), after an interim tariff-crash low of $1,471 on 2025-04-08

mETH Protocol: cmETH withdrawals paused inside the 8h delay window — PROTECTIVE freeze that recovered $43M from the attacker
Chainflip: temporarily disabled frontend swaps, then shipped protocol-level screening

causes.primary: Supply-chain compromise of Safe{Wallet}'s web frontend (developer workstation breach -> AWS session-token hijack -> targeted malicious JS in the S3-served UI) combined with blind signing: Bybit's three multisig signers approved a delegatecall that swapped the Safe mastercopy while their screens (and hardware-wallet hash displays) showed a routine transfer
secondary: Single point of failure: all signers used the same compromised web UI with no independent transaction-decoding verification (no EIP-712 clear-signing path, no second-channel simulation)
Hardware wallets display opaque hashes for Safe transactions — 'verified' signing that verifies nothing human-readable
Predictable, high-value routine cold-to-warm transfers gave the attacker a known window
DPRK state-actor capability and patience (workstation compromised 17 days before execution; JS activated only for the target address)
Industry-level: no-KYC swap infrastructure (THORChain, eXch) enabled laundering of ~$1.4B in 10 days
causes.mechanism: Feb 4: Safe dev workstation infected via trojanized Docker project -> AWS session tokens hijacked, MFA bypassed -> Feb 19: malicious JS planted in app.safe.global S3 bucket, conditioned on Bybit's cold-wallet address -> Feb 21 14:16 UTC: during routine transfer, JS masks the payload; 3-of-N signers blind-sign delegatecall replacing Safe mastercopy -> attacker controls wallet, drains ~$1.46B in ETH/LSTs across ~40+ txs -> JS scrubbed from S3 within ~2 min -> withdrawal run on Bybit -> bridged loans + OTC ETH buybacks close the gap in 72h -> funds converted to BTC via THORChain within 10 days

contagion: Safe{Wallet} developer workstation compromise (Feb 4) -> targeted JS injection in app.safe.global (Feb 19)
Masked delegatecall blind-signed by Bybit multisig -> $1.46B ETH/stETH/cmETH/mETH drained (Feb 21 14:16 UTC)
Withdrawal run on Bybit: ~350k requests, ~$4-6B outflows — but withdrawals never suspended
Inter-exchange liquidity backstop: Bitget 40k ETH loan, MEXC stETH, whale deposits, Galaxy/FalconX/Wintermute OTC buys (~$740M+) -> ETH briefly bid ABOVE pre-hack price (Feb 23)
Gap closed + audited 1:1 PoR (Feb 24) -> run subsides, NO insolvency, NO CeFi credit contagion (the counterfactual: an FTX-style freeze would have hit Ethena's short-leg venues and CeFi credit desks)
Safe{Wallet} UI outage Feb 21-26 -> operational freeze for thousands of DAO/treasury multisigs (no funds lost)
Laundering wave: THORChain record $4.66B weekly volume + governance crisis; Chainflip screening; eXch defection (later seized)
Sector confidence hit compounds macro risk-off (tariffs + record ETF outflows) -> BTC <$90k Feb 25, ETH -31.5% by Mar 10 — macro-dominated tail, hack-attributable share only the first ~4%

recovery.recovered: Bybit: yes — solvency/1:1 backing restored within ~72h (Hacken-verified PoR by Feb 24); stolen funds: mostly NOT recovered (~3% frozen ≈ $43M as of Mar 4 2025, plus 15k cmETH ≈ $43M clawed back; the rest converted to BTC and dispersed). Market: slow
recovery.time_to_recover: Exchange gap: 3 days. Safe{Wallet} service: 5 days (Feb 26). BTC regained pre-event daily close 2025-05-08 (~11 weeks); ETH not until 2025-06-10 (~16 weeks), after an interim tariff-crash low of $1,471 on 2025-04-08 (Coin Metrics daily)
recovery.notes: Bybit retained market share and later resumed growth; the event became the canonical proof that a CEX can absorb the largest theft in crypto history without a withdrawal freeze IF reserves exceed the hole and the response is fast and transparent. Contrast: FTX (fraud + hole -> freeze -> collapse). Industry response: clear-signing/EIP-712 push, Safe infrastructure rebuild, transaction-simulation adoption, and the THORChain neutrality debate

Two evidence tiers are used. TIER 1 — OBSERVED (computed directly from the local Coin Metrics daily dataset, high confidence): every price, drawdown, peg and recovery-date figure (ETH -3.1% d/d hack day, Feb 23 rebound to $2,821.9, -31.5% Feb 17->Mar 10, -46.4% to Apr 8; BTC -19.7% Feb 20->Mar 10, first <$90k close Feb 25; USDC/USDT/DAI mins 0.9996/0.9985/0.99958; BTC recovery 2025-05-08, ETH 2025-06-10). TIER 2 — REPORTED (from the assistant's knowledge of the primary sources listed; the event is inside the Jan-2026 cutoff and among the best-documented in crypto history, but figures could not be re-fetched here — treat as 'reported, re-verify on replay ingest'): $1.46B total and the 401,347 ETH / 90,375.5 stETH / 15,000 cmETH / 8,000 mETH split; 14:16 UTC execution; Feb 4 / Feb 19 forensic dates; ~350k withdrawals ~99% in ~12h; ~$740M+ buybacks / ~446,870 ETH replenished; THORChain ~$4.66B week and ~$5.5M fees; 77/20/3% traceability and ~$43M frozen; eXch seizure €34M. CONTESTED/RANGE: total loss is quoted $1.4B-$1.5B across sources ($1.46B Chainalysis/Elliptic — used here; $1.436B in this repo's own research/yield_research_2026.md; '$1.5B' FBI headline). BRIEF CORRECTIONS: (1) 'ETH -23% over following weeks' — computed values are -29.2% (Feb 21 close -> Mar 10) or -33.4% (Feb 23 rebound high -> Mar 10); the slide was predominantly MACRO (tariffs, record ETF outflows), with only the first ~3-4% plausibly hack-attributable; (2) 'BTC -7.5% intraday Feb 25' — daily close change was only -3.4% (Coin Metrics); intraday drop was reported ~6-7.5% and its attribution is primarily the tariff confirmation + record ~$1.1B one-day spot-ETF outflow, NOT the hack; (3) note ETH initially traded UP through Feb 23 on Bybit's buyback — the naive 'hack -> immediate crash' story is wrong for the first 48h. spa_relevance.direct_hits: None. A $100k USDC portfolio in Aave v3 / Pendle PT / Maple / Morpho Steakhouse + 10% cash rides through with near-zero NAV impact: USDC min $0.9996, no DeFi protocol touched, no withdrawal freeze on any held venue, no bad debt, oracles normal.
channels_that_did_move: APY collapse (the real P&L channel): ETH -31% + risk-off gutted leveraged borrow demand -> USDC supply APYs on Aave/Morpho compressed over the following weeks; a yield forecast anchored to Feb 2025 rates overstates realized carry
Pendle PT mark-to-market: risk-off widens implied yields -> MTM dip if PTs are sold pre-maturity (par at maturity is unaffected); PT liquidity thins exactly when rotation is tempting

Maple: borrower base is trading firms holding collateral on CEXes — a Bybit failure (the counterfactual) transmits into Maple credit; the realized event shows the channel exists even when it does not fire
unpriced_if_usdc_equals_1_and_always_wit: Operational signing / front-end supply-chain risk: the system's own future custody (Safe-based multisig at go-live) carries masked-transaction risk that NO market-risk model prices; the mitigations are procedural (independent tx decoding, second-device verification, no single UI dependency) — directly relevant to SPA's go-live custody design

Embedded CeFi counterparty risk inside 'DeFi' yields: Ethena-type basis strategies (short legs on Bybit et al.) and Maple credit are one bad hack-response away from a counterparty freeze; a model that treats all whitelisted yield as on-chain-only misprices this

Withdrawal-delay ambivalence: cmETH's 8h delay SAVED $43M — a scoring model that treats instant withdrawability as strictly good (and delay windows purely as liquidity risk) misprices protective friction

Contagion asymmetry lesson for the kill-switch: the drawdown here was macro-entangled and slow (-5% tier would have tripped on the Feb 24-26 leg from beta exposure, not from the hack); for a USDC-only book the correct sensor is counterparty/peg telemetry, not price drawdown — this scenario stresses the monitoring layer, not the ladder
spa_relevance.backtest_note: As a replay scenario this is a NEAR-MISS template: inject (a) 2-3 weeks of stable-APY compression, (b) a PT implied-yield widening shock, and (c) a counterfactual branch where the exchange freezes withdrawals (Ethena/Maple stress) to price what the realized history left unpriced
